title: Repair Remote Desktop Commander autostart on 3EN035
description: READ->EVIDENCE->CONCLUSION->BACKUP->ONE LOGICAL CHANGE->TEST. Discover the existing Remote Desktop Commander launch command from running processes, scheduled tasks, npm/npx caches or command resolution; back up current startup evidence; create or repair a per-user scheduled task with delayed logon trigger; start RDC now; verify process. Do not delete application data or unrelated tasks.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$evidence=$root+'/rdc-autostart-repair-evidence.txt';'=== RDC AUTOSTART REPAIR ==='|Set-Content $evidence;('DATE='+(Get-Date -Format s))|Add-Content $evidence;('USER='+$env:USERNAME)|Add-Content $evidence;$cmdLine=$null;$proc=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -match '(?i)(desktop-commander|wonderwhy-er)'}|Select-Object -First 1;if($proc){$cmdLine=$proc.CommandLine;('SOURCE=running-process PID='+$proc.ProcessId)|Add-Content $evidence;('CMD='+$cmdLine)|Add-Content $evidence};$oldTasks=Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.TaskName -match '(?i)(desktop.?commander|remote.?desktop.?commander|3EN.?RDC|RDC)' -or (($_.Actions|Out-String) -match '(?i)(desktop-commander|wonderwhy-er)')};if(-not $cmdLine){foreach($t in $oldTasks){foreach($a in $t.Actions){$candidate=(($a.Execute+' '+$a.Arguments).Trim());if($candidate -match '(?i)(desktop-commander|wonderwhy-er)'){$cmdLine=$candidate;('SOURCE=scheduled-task '+$t.TaskName)|Add-Content $evidence;('CMD='+$cmdLine)|Add-Content $evidence;break}};if($cmdLine){break}}};if(-not $cmdLine){$npx=(Get-Command npx.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if(-not $npx){$npx=(Get-Command npx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source};if($npx){$cmdLine='"'+$npx+'" -y @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander';('SOURCE=npx-discovery')|Add-Content $evidence;('CMD='+$cmdLine)|Add-Content $evidence}};if(-not $cmdLine){$pkg=Get-ChildItem ($env:LOCALAPPDATA+'/npm-cache/_npx') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|ForEach-Object{Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -Filter package.json -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}|Where-Object{$_.FullName -match '(?i)wonderwhy-er.*desktop-commander'}|Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending|Select-Object -First 1;if($pkg){$base=Split-Path (Split-Path $pkg.FullName -Parent) -Parent;$js=Get-ChildItem $base -Recurse -Filter index.js -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.FullName -match '(?i)desktop-commander.*dist'}|Select-Object -First 1;if($js){$node=(Get-Command node.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source;if($node){$cmdLine='"'+$node+'" "'+$js.FullName+'"';('SOURCE=npm-cache')|Add-Content $evidence;('CMD='+$cmdLine)|Add-Content $evidence}}}};if(-not $cmdLine){throw 'RDC_LAUNCH_COMMAND_NOT_DISCOVERED'};foreach($t in $oldTasks){if($t.TaskName -ne '3EN-RemoteDesktopCommander-Autostart'){Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t.TaskName -TaskPath $t.TaskPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Out-Null;('DISABLED_OLD_TASK='+$t.TaskPath+$t.TaskName)|Add-Content $evidence}};$action=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'cmd.exe' -Argument ('/d /c '+$cmdLine) -WorkingDirectory $env:USERPROFILE;$trigger=New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn -User $env:USERNAME;$trigger.Delay='PT45S';$settings=New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -StartWhenAvailable -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Days 365);$principal=New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $env:USERNAME -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited;Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN-RemoteDesktopCommander-Autostart' -Action $action -Trigger $trigger -Settings $settings -Principal $principal -Description '3EN035 Remote Desktop Commander delayed autostart; repaired 2026-09-11' -Force|Out-Null;('TASK_REGISTERED=3EN-RemoteDesktopCommander-Autostart')|Add-Content $evidence;$existing=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -match '(?i)(desktop-commander|wonderwhy-er)'}|Select-Object -First 1;if(-not $existing){Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName '3EN-RemoteDesktopCommander-Autostart';Start-Sleep 8};Write-Host 'RDC_AUTOSTART_REPAIR_EXECUTED'
